fact_text: Saudi and Pakistani private-sector members of a new business council agreed to set up a private equity fund with equal contributions from both sides.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Proceeds of the Pakistan-Saudi private equity fund are to be split, with 75% invested in Pakistan and 25% in Saudi Arabia.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The fund is expected to take about six months to become operational: roughly three months of regulatory approval after signing, then about three months for capital calls.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The fund's initial target is $500 million, with the aim of growing it to multiple billions of dollars over time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: In an illustrative $1 billion fund, $750 million would be invested in Pakistan: $500 million of local money plus $250 million of Saudi money, with the other $250 million going to Saudi Arabia.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The fund is expected to target agriculture, mining, IT, construction, real estate development, government infrastructure and monetisation of government land-bank assets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Government offers for motorway, airport, seaport and railway development are to be open to participation by this fund.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: An investment of $750 million in Pakistan's government bonds was reported in Nov 2026, according to Arif Habib.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Pakistan re-entered the international debt market in 2026 and its credit rating has been raised, Arif Habib said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Letters of interest for privatising power projects were received from Turkish and Indonesian investors, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Arif Habib said Qatar is actively looking at Pakistan's investment opportunities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Government officials say the IMF programme limits room to cut the cost of doing business, so any room found is passed on to businesses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The government has cut electricity prices, which Arif Habib said is only a partial step, and further cuts are needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Interest rates fell from very high levels but rose again on renewed inflation; further cuts depend on bringing inflation under control.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The budget cut some high tax rates, which Arif Habib called insufficient, and the government says it aims to reduce them further.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The FBR chairman has said the super tax should not exist, and the budget lowered it somewhat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Business confidence depends on policy continuity and macroeconomic stability, which the government must keep on track, Arif Habib said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Arif Habib said Pakistan suffers from negative perception, and that media coverage highlights bad news far more than good news.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Each successive Saudi delegation visiting Pakistan has been larger than the previous one, which Arif Habib said is improving perception of Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Saudi Investors Commit 75% of New Investment Fund to Pakistan | Arif Habib Reveals | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)
